items.detail: The **Nasdaq** closed at a record **27,477.31** on Monday, up 1.1%, while the S&P 500 rose 0.7% to 7,773.95, within 0.3% of its summer high.
items.why: Nvidia hit a second straight record, and fading bets on a Fed hike after the jobs miss kept buyers in tech.

items.detail: Stocks rallied even as the **30-year Treasury yield** climbed toward its highest level since 2002, a split that leaves the record rally exposed to rates.
items.why: A global bond selloff is lifting long-term borrowing costs even as short-term Fed hike bets cool.

items.detail: MSCI's emerging-market stock gauge climbed as much as **1.1%** on Monday, its best day in about two weeks, led by Taiwan, where TSMC rose 2.6%.
items.why: Weak US jobs data cooled Fed hike bets and oil fell further, helping EM stocks and currencies. China and Korea were closed.

items.detail: The **Nifty 50** rose 0.6% to **22,555.75** on Monday, ending a four-day losing streak, ahead of the RBI's rate decision on Wednesday.
items.why: Easing oil and lower US hike bets lifted the market, but foreign funds still sold ₹4,699 crore.

items.detail: The US **Russell 2000** rose 0.5% to **2,847.14** on Monday, a third straight gain, while India's Nifty Smallcap 100 added a similar 0.47%.
items.why: Fading Fed hike odds help debt-heavy small companies most, though rising long-term yields kept the gains modest.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** is holding near **$86,000**, up from about $84,600 on Saturday, after touching an eight-month high above $87,000 but failing to break through.
items.why: Lower Fed hike bets kept buyers in, but ETF inflows slowed sharply last week, which capped the move.

items.detail: **Ether** recovered to about **$2,716**, back above the weekend's $2,690, as the Glamsterdam upgrade's testnet goes live Tuesday.
items.why: Upgrade hopes are offsetting about $155 million of ether ETF outflows over four straight sessions.

items.detail: **Solana** slipped back below $120 to about **$119.99**, down roughly 1.2% in a day, giving back its Friday rebound.
items.why: Bitcoin held its gains, but the short squeeze behind Solana's Friday jump faded and no new buyer stepped in.

items.detail: **Spot gold** slid to about **$4,130** on Tuesday, erasing Friday's jump to $4,217 after falling 0.9% on Monday.
items.why: Long-term Treasury yields near multi-decade highs and a firmer dollar outweighed lower Fed hike odds, and speculators kept cutting bets.

crossCuttingTheme: Lower Fed hike odds after the jobs miss are still lifting tech, emerging markets, small caps and bitcoin, but a global bond selloff pushing long-term yields to multi-decade highs is pulling gold down and limiting the rally.
